name: Soap pump bottle
summary: Pressing the pump head down squirts liquid soap out of the spout, and the head rises again ready for the next press.

parts.name: Collar
parts.role: The ring that screws the pump onto the bottle.

parts.name: Pump head
parts.role: The top you press down, with the spout the soap comes out of.

parts.name: Dip tube
parts.role: A thin tube reaching down to the bottom of the soap.
